outputs.explanation: Panel A contains an H&E micrograph and spatial gene-expression heatmap plots (log2 expression overlaid on tissue spots). Heatmaps are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel B consists solely of H&E and RNAscope fluorescence micrographs; there is no plot of averaged data, so the check does not apply.

Panel C is a scatter plot (dot plot) showing every patient sample as an individual point, with median and 95% CI indicated. Scatter plots inherently display individual data points, so they are exempt from requiring additional overlay.
Panel D is a bar chart (mean ± SD) with the individual replicate values (n=3 per group) overlaid as dots, satisfying the requirement to show underlying data points alongside the average.
